From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Russian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • гос- (gos-) (abbreviation)

Etymology

[edit]

госуда́рство (gosudárstvo) +‎ -енный (-ennyj)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ɡəsʊˈdarstvʲɪn(ː)ɨj]
  • Audio:(file)

Adjective

[edit]

госуда́рственный • (gosudárstvennyj) (no comparative)

  1. (relational) state
  2. national
  3. (law) public
    госуда́рственный переворо́т ― gosudárstvennyj perevorót ― coup d'état (literally, “public revolution”)
